bulk_import_subtitle: Upload your CSV file to create or update multiple products at once.
bulk_instruction_1: Name and prices are required. Supplier/invoice code is optional; blank is saved without a code. measurement_unit accepts unit, kg, g or bundle: new products default to unit, while omitted units on updates are preserved. Changing an existing product unit requires its current ID and version.
bulk_instruction_2: If you include an existing product ID (id), it will be updated. If omitted or empty, it will be created.
bulk_instruction_3: Rows with errors will appear with a red circle at the top. Modify or remove them to proceed with the import.

provider_bulk_import_subtitle: Upload your CSV file to create or update multiple providers at once.
provider_bulk_instruction_1: Use the template or a provider download. Optionally include contacts in the contacts JSON column. Keep fields_json and csv_version to preserve the full mapping when importing again.
provider_bulk_instruction_2: With an ID, that provider is updated within the business. Without an ID, create or update by name within the business; ambiguous names require an ID. The entire import is saved together or nothing is saved.
provider_bulk_instruction_3: Rows with errors will appear with a red circle sorted at the top. Modify or remove them to process the upload.

pos.image_viewer_save_help: You can change or remove the image. Press Save image to apply your change; the product's other data is preserved.
pos.image_product_error: The product could not be loaded to view its image.
pos.image_only_review: Review the current image and your change. Confirm allows applying it against the current product version; its other data is preserved. Then press Save image.
pos.product_save_unknown: We could not confirm whether the product was saved. Check the catalog before trying again to avoid duplicates. Your draft is still here.
pos.product_saved_image_pending: The product was saved. The image is still pending; your draft is kept so you can finish without creating another product.
pos.image_review_before_retry: The product changed while the image was uploading. Review recent changes before applying it.

field_help.name: Name used to identify the product in the catalog and point of sale.
field_help.code: Invoice code or supplier reference. It is separate from the barcode.
field_help.barcode: Link the code returned by your scanner to this product. Focus this field and scan or type it; Save applies the change.
field_help.cost_price: Base cost before tax. Updates only the tax-inclusive cost using the tax rate.
field_help.tax_rate: Percentage used to calculate the cost including tax. It does not add tax when recording a sale.
field_help.cost_price_tax: Tax-inclusive base cost. Updates only the net cost using the tax rate.
field_help.sale_price: Final regular price in CLP. Sales use it when the alternative price is disabled.
field_help.offer_price: Another final price in CLP. It may be lower, equal or higher than the regular price; it is used only when its switch is enabled.
field_help.is_offer_enabled: Use the alternative price for new sales. Disabling it preserves the configured amount.
field_help.has_stock: Availability you set manually. It does not count units; only available products can be added to a sale.
field_help.provider_id: Supplier associated with the product. You can leave it unassigned.
field_help.is_active: Allows use of this product. Inactive products remain in history and cannot be added to new sales.

pos.image_save_help: The image is optional. Select it here and press Save to apply it with the product.
pos.image_remove_on_save: The image will be removed when you save. Cancel keeps the saved image.
pos.inspect_product_explanation: Compare the saved data with your draft. Changed fields are highlighted. Confirm keeps your draft and lets you save it against this revision; it does not save the product yet.
pos.inspect_sale_explanation: Review the current saved sale. Confirming loads these data and replaces unsaved local changes; cancelling keeps your cart.
pos.invalid_quantity: Enter a quantity from 0 to 2,147,483,647, with up to 3 decimal places.
pos.cart_limit: A sale supports up to 200 different products.
pos.image_remove_confirm: The image will no longer appear in the catalog. Previous sales will be preserved.
pos.image_apply_explanation: The product changed. Review the image and confirm applying it to the current version without uploading it again.

pos.barcode_input_help: Focus this field, then scan or type the barcode. Select Save to apply it.
pos.invalid_price: Enter a valid whole CLP amount.
pos.invalid_barcode: Enter a valid barcode without outer spaces.

pos.image_retry: The attempt has ended. You may select the image again.
pos.image_error: The image could not be loaded.
pos.image_pending: The upload needs reconciliation. Do not send the file again.
pos.image_after_save: An image is optional. Save the product and open its editor to upload one.

pos.scan_ready: Enter or scan the complete barcode and confirm with Enter.

pos.barcode_unknown_value: Barcode {{barcode}} is not linked to a product in this business.

pos.rescan: Barcode linked. Scan again to add the product.

pos.cart_empty: Scan a barcode or select a product to start the sale.
pos.informative_payment: The method is informational. Recording a sale does not collect or verify payment.
pos.unsaved: Review the cart and select Confirm sale to register it.
pos.prices_reviewed: Prices updated. Review the cart before confirming.
pos.confirm_total: A sale for {{total}} will be recorded. Review products, quantities and informational payment method.
pos.confirm_explanation: Review the effect before continuing. Catalog changes do not modify confirmed sales.
pos.leave_message: You have changes in open sales. Leaving discards them; returning starts an empty Sale 1.
pos.sales_empty: No sales for this period or filter.
pos.report_explanation: Includes confirmed sales. Cancelled sales are excluded from their original period; this does not represent payments or cash balance.
pos.providers_explanation: Active business suppliers. Numeric inventory is not calculated.
pos.checkout_invalid: Add products and check the total and payment method before confirming.
pos.checkout_invalid_result: We could not validate the returned sale. Check the result before trying again.
pos.sale_empty_help: Scan its barcode or search by name to get started.
pos.sales_period_help: The period uses confirmation date in America/Santiago and includes both days.
pos.average_per_sale_help: Total sales amount divided by confirmed sales, rounded to the nearest peso.
pos.close_sale_explanation: This cart and its products will be removed. Other open sales will be kept.
pos.workspace_storage_error: We could not keep or restore all carts in this browser tab. Available information is preserved; resolve storage before confirming.
pos.legacy_other_select: This cart used Other. Choose an available payment method to continue.
pos.cannot_close_pending: Check this sale’s result before closing it.
pos.zero_quantity_help: This row does not add to the total. It will be removed automatically when you confirm the sale.
pos.mixed_unit_ranking_help: Each quantity uses its displayed unit. To compare products with different units, sort by sales amount.
pos.unit_changed: A product unit changed. Remove and add it again to review its quantity and price.
pos.price_permanent: Save the product regular price and disable its offer
pos.invalid_manual_price: Enter a valid price in pesos, without decimals
pos.price_changed_review: The product changed. Review current prices before changing it
pos.leave_pending_message: An operation is in progress or has an unconfirmed result. Review it before leaving.
